summary.text: Andrea Zupancich is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Grant Hauschild.
She also ran for the seat in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Zupancich won the August 9, 2022 Republican primary for Minnesota State Senate District 3 with 69.1 percent of the vote over Kelsey Johnson.
She lost the 2022 general election to Grant Hauschild, 50.8 percent to 49.1 percent.
Her 2026 Republican primary was canceled, and she advanced to the general election without appearing on the primary ballot.
